diagnosis: Generic workers could execute and embody guide roles, but backlog replenishment still depended on pre-seeded guide jobs. Once those were consumed, the network could again depend on a privileged guide chat to create the next planning/rescate job.
intervention: Added a deterministic self-materializing guide-job policy driven by durable state, bound it into the public /wc entry, and seeded an independent end-to-end canary that must prove guide-job creation -> durable output -> successor claim/execution without /g routing.
tests: GitHub Pages deployment for gh-pages commit d41a2907f2b3a03846a041d3f110edac6a19c342 completed SUCCESS.
The public /wc entry now explicitly requires GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1 and METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 before allocation.
A dedicated claimable metabolism canary exists on main.
remaining_boundary: Sustained useful compounding is not yet proven. The canary must demonstrate repeated productive generations where consumed results create >1 grounded successor on average and successors are actually claimed/executed without human routing.
